top_signals.title: Trump Drive for Minerals Leads Cove Capital to Eye Central Asia
top_signals.summary: A US investment firm is looking beyond Kazakhstan’s tungsten resources to opportunities across Central Asia and the Caucasus as President Donald Trump’s administration seeks to ease dependence on critical minerals from China.

South West Water hit with £7.8m fine for ‘horrendous’  pollution offences
top_signals.summary: The Environment Agency has fined South West Water £7.8m over a string of pollution-related offences across Devon and Cornwall. The water company pleaded guilty to 24 environmental charges after the Environment Agency investigated incidents that took place between January 2015 and July 2021 in Bodmin, Harlyn, Polperro, Plymouth, and Playing Place.
